name: 로컬 위상 양자화
description: 분석합니다 local phase information in the 주파수 영역 감지하기 위해 limited phase diversity in AI 생성 textures.
algorithm: LPQ Descriptor with Short-Term 푸리에 Transform
mechanism: Computes STFT at each pixel neighborhood and quantizes the phase of frequency components. AI images typically exhibit concentrated LPQ 분포s with limited phase diversity.
parameters: Window: 5×5, Frequencies: 4 basis, Quantization: 8-bit binary code, Histogram: 256 bins
source: Ojansivu & Heikkilä (2008) — Blur Insensitive Texture Classification, ICISP
useCase: Detecting reduced phase diversity in AI 생성 local textures

references.title: Ojansivu, V. & Heikkilä, J. (2008). Blur Insensitive Texture Classification Using LPQ. ICISP.

strengths:
• Blur-insensitive texture descriptor
• Captures phase information lost in magnitude-only methods
• Robust to moderate image degradation
• Complementary to LBP 분석
limitations:
• 계산 비용이 높음
• Limited spatial 해상도
• May not capture large-scale 패턴
• Best used in combination with other methods
